summary: Both tests exercise the real CodexHarness.argv() over real rollout files with real os.utime mtimes, no mocking; the new float-precision test independently proves stat().st_mtime collapses two 1ns-apart mtimes to an identical float (confirmed a simulated float-based selector picks the wrong, older session) while st_mtime_ns distinguishes them, and asserts the harness resumes the genuinely newer rollout, directly covering the 'most recently written' boundary; the pre-existing test independently rules out name/creation-order as the ordering signal.
